cases.name: jsonrpc-lone-surrogate

reference.stderr: jsontext: invalid surrogate pair `\ud800"}` in string within "/params" after offset 50

cases.rationale: The user selected UTF-8/WTF-8 throughout the C# implementation. Preserve lone surrogate code units in JSON-RPC source and name values; the original Go JSON-RPC decoder rejects this input, although its binary API accepts it.
cases.independentControl: The exact response JSON is parsed by Node and checked for the original U+D800 code unit.

cases.name: jsonrpc-truncated-header
cases.rationale: EOF is clean only between frames. Reject a partially received header so a truncated request is distinguishable from an orderly disconnect; the Go header reader treats this partial header as clean EOF.
cases.independentControl: Input contains a nonempty unfinished Content-Length header. Both peers emit no response; their exit status and error output are compared.
